bio: From his face plastered on the shields of his Highguard to the giant golden throne he insists he rules from, Thalbrennar is not what you'd call a modest ruler. Despite an attitude that some would describe as egotistical, he is beloved by the people of Stoneloom. His larger than life persona, and strength to match, make a welcome change from the sterile rulers of old.
